agency.fullName: Agency for Border Integration and Regional Development (AIFDR)
agency.description: AIFDR coordinates infrastructure projects, trade agreements, and open data across the Brazil, Guyana, and Venezuela borders.
agency.address: Civic Center Square, Boa Vista, Roraima, Brazil

home.heroTitle: Cooperation and transparency at the northern border
home.heroSummary: Access international agreements, freight transport guides, and regional economic indicators.
home.service1Desc: Review the documents required for moving goods through the Pacaraima and Bonfim customs posts.
home.service2Desc: Read energy, health, and education cooperation treaties signed among the three countries.
home.service3Desc: Track monthly trade balance flows and migration movement in open formats.

about.heading: Who we are and what we do
about.intro: The Agency for Border Integration and Regional Development (AIFDR) has worked since 2018 to facilitate technical and economic dialogue among neighboring communities.
about.pillar1Desc: We plan improvements along highways BR-174 and BR-401 to reduce regional transit times.
about.pillar2Desc: We guide local exporters on sanitary rules and customs tariffs.
about.pillar3Desc: We publish verified monthly statistics without requiring citizen registration.
